item.title: Notebookcheck: TypAir wearable keyboard turns finger gestures into text
item.description: MindRove's TypAir takes an unusual approach to typing, replacing physical keys with finger movements on a device attached to your clothing. The Bluetooth accessory is designed for compatible smart glasses, phones, and other devices, allowing users to write without speaking aloud. It's currently a functional prototype, with preorder prices starting at $99.
